items.q: My father ___ to office every day. (go)
The girls ___ in the garden now. (walk)
items.rule_bn: 'now' = এই মুহূর্তে, Present Continuous: are walking।
'since' + এখনো চলছে, Present Perfect: have been।

items.q: I ___ my homework before he came. (finish)
items.rule_bn: অতীতে আগের কাজ Past Perfect: had finished।
'since morning' চলমান: Present Perfect Continuous: has been raining।

items.q: Ice ___ into water when it is heated.
items.rule_bn: সাধারণ সত্য Present Indefinite; ice=It, তাই turns।

items.q: He ___ TV when I entered the room. (watch)
items.rule_bn: অতীতে চলমান কাজ Past Continuous: was watching।

items.q: By next year, I ___ my graduation. (complete)
items.rule_bn: ভবিষ্যতে নির্দিষ্ট সময়ে শেষ: Future Perfect: will have completed।
